tagline: Lifting you up to walk into your destiny

home.heroHeadline: The truth is not established by man, but by God. We here to lift you up and walk into your destiny.
home.heroSubheadline: Our mission is to help you to overcome whatever obstacles that you are facing, but it all starts with you. We will celebrate you.
home.missionStatement: Empowering individuals and communities through faith-based life coaching, mentorship, and transformative programs.
home.lifeCoachBio: Sharon Bedford works tirelessly to ensure follow-through on commitments to a better life and personal accountability. With compassion and dedication, she guides individuals through life's challenges, helping them discover their God-given purpose and walk confidently into their destiny.

about.title: About Us
about.missionText: The Enough Is Enough Foundation is dedicated to helping individuals overcome life's obstacles through faith, community support, and professional life coaching. We believe that transformation starts from within, and we are here to celebrate every step of your journey toward a better life.
about.overviewText: Founded on the principle that everyone deserves a chance to thrive, our foundation provides comprehensive programs for men and women seeking purpose, accountability, and community. Through grants and community contributions, we make our services accessible to those who need them most.

items.title: Men Of Hope
items.description: A comprehensive mentorship program empowering men to overcome challenges, build accountability, and discover their God-given purpose through community support and faith-based guidance.

items.title: How Much Do You Know
items.description: An educational initiative designed to expand knowledge, build awareness, and foster personal growth through interactive workshops and community learning experiences.

items.title: When All of God's Children Gets Together
items.description: A unity-focused community program bringing people together across backgrounds to foster understanding, fellowship, and collective empowerment through faith.

items.title: Connecting to My RIB
items.description: A personal development program helping individuals connect with their inner strength, relationships, identity, and beliefs to build a foundation for lasting transformation.

items.title: Women Of Destiny
items.description: Empowering women to embrace their calling, overcome obstacles, and walk confidently into their destiny through mentorship, support groups, and faith-centered coaching.

items.title: Housing for Men Of Hope
items.description: Providing safe, supportive housing solutions for men participating in the Men Of Hope program, creating a stable foundation for personal growth and community reintegration.
